crossRefs.note: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.
Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!
“Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand…

translations.web: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
translations.bsb: Then call me, and I will answer, or let me speak, and You can reply.
translations.kjv: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer
translations.asv: Then call thou, and I will answer; Or let me speak, and answer thou me.
